title: Mistral Medium model surfaces in backend logs at ~128B parameters
summary: Mistral AI signalled a major release and a new model named Mistral Medium has been appearing across backend rebuilds. Internal labels put Mistral Small at about 119 billion parameters and the upcoming Medium variant at around 128 billion, raising questions about whether it is dense or less sparse than the Small variant.

web_findings.snippet: Released 29 April 2026, 128B dense multimodal model with 256K context.
